deals.title: RT by @CardExpert_IN: Completed one year with my ICICI Emeralde Private Metal (EPM) Credit Card. With the recent Infinia devaluations, I think EPM is the better premium card, at least for now. 😄 And finally, one completely non-financial benefit... There's something oddly satisfying about pulling out that emerald green metal card every time I pay. 😄
